description.p: 1983 is a compatibility-focused MSX and MSX2 emulator written in C with SDL3. It is a sibling project of the 1984 Amstrad CPC emulator and the 1985 Amstrad PCW emulator, reusing their window, overlay, shortcut, notification, LED, and configuration conventions.

It runs MSX1 and MSX2 firmware, cartridges, cassettes, raw floppy images, Sunrise IDE disks, and SD Mapper media. An optional openMSXnet-compatible bridge supplies host TCP/IP UNAPI networking. A redistributable RainBIOS Omega MSX2 unified ROM is included as the ready-to-run default, with C-BIOS available as a bundled MSX1 model.
First packaged release with bundled C-BIOS defaults, MSX1/MSX2 emulation, cartridge and mass-storage extensions, RPM and Flatpak definitions, and automated Linux, Windows, and macOS builds.
Initial frontend and executable MSX1 scaffold with C-BIOS boot validation.
